_comment: Tier-2 for skfem linear_elasticity#2, previously flagged 'claim inherited -- not yet empirically separated'. Now measured on skfem 12.0.1: linear_elasticity(lam, mu) IS a skfem.assembly.form.BilinearForm instance (not an integrand), asm() returns an (N, N) scipy sparse matrix on a vector basis, and calling it on a SCALAR basis raises rather than silently assembling.
